name: multiply_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::multiply_.Tensor(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor other) -> Tensor(a!). The correctness suite also covers the Scalar overload. Both overloads perform elementwise multiplication in place, mutate self, and return the same Tensor object and storage. The tests cover equal-shape and broadcast Tensor operands, Scalar operands, zero-sized and noncontiguous inputs, floating-point special values, gradients through a non-leaf in-place input, and rejection of a non-broadcastable operand.
